# João Palmeiro

> Personal website of João Palmeiro, Data Visualization Engineer at Feedzai.

---

# AI

I use AI directly for two purposes: coding and searching. I use it via chat interfaces, easily integrating them into my workflow. This way, access is similar to other tools like my notes/repos and the Internet. The outcome is adequate.

## Coding

I use AI primarily for four coding-related tasks:

1. Code review/linting: I use AI to help validate code and detect potential issues and improvements. This approach is particularly useful when I am not proficient in a specific technology and can add relevant documentation to the prompt.
2. Code conversion: I use AI to convert code from one programming language to another (R to Python, for example). This way, I have an additional reference to implement my own version.
3. Example generation: I use AI to generate small demos combining different technologies. I take this approach when I can't find good examples online that include all the technologies I'm interested in.
4. Error debugging: I use AI to understand the cause and potential solutions for certain errors. I resort to this approach when I can't find useful information online.

The initial prompt contains at least code, an instruction, and a set of conditions/requirements (specific major package versions, for example). Often, I also add additional content as context, such as a documentation page. I don't keep any of the prompts, so the prompt template is different every time.

## Searching

I turn to AI when I have something concrete I want to find and only have a vague description in mind. I resort to it only after trying to find what I'm looking for in a search engine.

# João Palmeiro

- Pronouns: he/him
- Location: Lisbon, Portugal (UTC+00:00 or +01:00)
- Contact: joaopalmeiro@proton.me

## Profile

A mix of data visualization practitioner, researcher, and software engineer. Experienced in developing interfaces and tools from ideation to production code, including project management. Used to working on accessibility and with AI/ML. Mainly familiar with the Python ecosystem and web technologies like React. Open to contributing where most needed and using any tech stack.
